name: retrieve_protein_structure
description: Use this tool to retrieve the 3D structure of a protein given its PDB ID. This tool is appropriate when you need structural data for a specific protein for analysis or visualization. Do not use this tool if you do not have a valid PDB ID or if you are looking for protein sequence data instead; consider using a sequence retrieval tool in that case.

parameters.name: pdb_id
parameters.description: The Protein Data Bank ID for the protein structure. Must be a 4-character alphanumeric string (e.g., '1A2B').

structure_data.description: The 3D structure data in a suitable format (e.g., PDB format).

pdb_id.description: The PDB ID of the retrieved structure.

status.description: Status of the retrieval operation (e.g., 'success' or 'error').

error_message.description: An error message if the retrieval fails, otherwise null.

return_schema.description: Returns the 3D structure data of the protein.
